mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, IDCARD_IMAGE_ENC AS idcardImageEnc, IDCARD_IMAGE_NONCE AS idcardImageNonce, IDCARD_IMAGE_TAG AS idcardImageTag, IDFACE_IMAGE_ENC AS idfaceImageEnc, IDFACE_IMAGE_NONCE AS idfaceImageNonce, IDFACE_IMAGE_TAG AS idfaceImageTag, OCR_RESULT_ENC AS ocrResultEnc, OCR_RESULT_NONCE AS ocrResultNonce, OCR_RESULT_TAG AS ocrResultTag, FACE_IMAGE_ENC AS faceImageEnc, FACE_IMAGE_NONCE AS faceImageNonce, FACE_IMAGE_TAG AS faceImageTag, SIMILARITY_SCORE AS similarityScore, PRIVACY_CONSENT_YN AS privacyConsentYn FROM TB_AUTHENTICATION WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_AUTHENTICATION ( MEMBER_NO, CREATED_AT, EXPIRE_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE + 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_AUTHENTICATION SET PRIVACY_CONSENT_YN = #{agreed, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EXPIRE_AT = SYSDATE + 1 WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

UPDATE TB_AUTHENTICATION SET IDCARD_IMAGE_ENC = #{idcardImageEnc, jdbcType=CLOB}, IDCARD_IMAGE_NONCE = #{idcardImageNonce, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IDCARD_IMAGE_TAG = #{idcardImageTag, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EXPIRE_AT = SYSDATE + 1 WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN IDCARD_IMAGE_ENC IS NOT NULL AND IDCARD_IMAGE_NONCE IS NOT NULL AND IDCARD_IMAGE_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM TB_AUTHENTICATION WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
